title: Derived restriction of a strict-local neighbourhood germ
statement: Let f, s, K, n, J, q and the canonical comparison A_i be as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison], and Q as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry]. Write ell_i for the canonical source germ leg [def-weil-pbc-small-model-cohomology-germs], m for the derived mate homology map, and T for the target iso [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-mate-projection-data]. For each i, ell_i m T equals A_i c_i followed by the derived cohomology restriction along Q.smallModelLegs.app i: the inverse-image adjunction unit, derived Leray, and inverse of the inverse-image composition comparison for Q.smallModelOver i. Here c_i is the canonical representativeSectionsComparison at the stage [lem-weil-pbc-injective-sections-pullback-comparison]. This statement does not identify the derived restriction with termwise restriction or assert acyclicity at the limit. Here smallModelLegs and its component equations are the canonical transports to the small coordinate-ring colimit model in [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-small-model-geometry-transport].

proof.text: The termwise direct image of the given bounded-below complex of injectives is bounded below and K-injective: the inverse-image left adjoint is exact, so direct image preserves injectives. Use sourceInjectiveDirectImageIso to obtain its specified representative r of Rf_*K.
Apply sourceLocalizedSectionsIso_germ to this representative on S. It factors the canonical source germ leg through cohomology of the actual complex of sections on the neighbourhood.

Apply strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction_mate to identify that base complex restriction followed by the derived mate and target isomorphism with stage sections identification, termwise fibre restriction, and the limit representative sections comparison.

The cone-leg clause of injectiveSections_strictLocal_comparison replaces termwise restriction followed by the limit comparison by the stage comparison followed by derived cohomology restriction. Unfold sourceLocalizedSectionsIso and strictLocalInjectiveSourceIso and reassociate: the localized Hom factors followed by the stage section factors are definitionally the original source isomorphism.

The geometry parameter is now the official canonical strictLocalization model. Use [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-small-model-geometry-transport] to express its cone on the original small colimit model. Replace legs, limit and the two component equations by smallModelLegs, smallModelIsLimit, smallModelFirst and smallModelOver. All cohomology objects, structural morphisms, source and target maps remain those in the original statement; the rest of the existing proof is unchanged.
Use the small-model germ legs without changing their component maps. The adopted six common derived-sections constructions are definitionally identical to the former local copies.
